What supposed to be a nice barbecue time but was full of deception
Sep 2025 • Family
My man and I went hin today hopping to have a great barbecue time but went out full of deception.

We arrive there at 19:00 and wanted to have the barbecue menu we saw on the website through TripAdvisor but the waitress informed that the menu was sold out.

After what we decided to take the hotspot menu from the given menu --> this was also sold out....

Finally we choose 2 times the barbecue menu for 1 person, a rice dish and 2 beers.

And guest what? the wagyu sausage was sold out and got pork belly instead.

We finally got served, started with someone grilling and end up doing it ourselves seeing how pationnate she was.

After ca.15 min we found it strange not to have some sauces nor salt to the served meat and asked for it.
This was bring to us directly with a smile without any apologise.

To round up the meat served was a bad quality meat.
At the demand she just explained that the non tenderness of those pieces was normal.. 

Till then we were trying to enjoy despite the circumstances but finally got outside full of deception.

I had some pictures of the menu and the received plate to show the gap (with the output of the meat we couldn't swallow)
